errors.right: Two wrapper theorems folded into this line state, each under the same premise SiegelWeilUnitaryConvergent, three conditions with matching names, SlotLpCondition, SlotOrderCondition and SlotTorsionFreeCondition.
errors.why: The Lean text of each wrapper begins with "HeckeCharacterZeroLocus.SiegelWeilU.SiegelWeilUnitaryConvergent → ∀", so each wrapper states the three conditions only under this premise, and the reading gives the quantifiers of the wrappers but not the premise.
